item.title: U.S. delays 50% tariff on Canadian imports. And, takeaways from Florida's primaries
item.description: President Trump has announced that the U.S. is delaying a 50% tariff on Canadian imports after reaching a deal. And, how progressive Democrats fared in Florida's primary elections yesterday.
